name: System Health Monitor

parameters.content: This workflow runs daily at 4:00 PM ET, checking appointment reminders (Workflow 09) and follow-up sequences (Workflow 05) for signs a scheduled workflow didn't run. If issues are found, it emails the owner a System Health Alert (SMS built but off by default - both toggled via the CONFIG block in 'Build Health Report'). Stays silent if everything looks fresh.

description: Daily 4PM ET freshness check on appointment reminders (WF09) and follow-ups (WF05). Emails owner if a scheduled workflow looks stale; silent otherwise. SMS built but off - configurable via CONFIG block in 'Build Health Report'.
